name: Chunk-based Voxel World Management
aliases: Chunk-based Voxel World Storage and Rendering
definition: A system for managing a voxel world by dividing it into fixed-size chunks, handling visibility culling against a frustum, and incrementally rebuilding chunks that have changed.
summary: Chunk-based Voxel World Management divides worlds into fixed-size chunks, using frustum culling and a rate-limited rebuild queue to prevent mesh generation from blocking the frame loop.
